metadata.measurements: Desktop Chromium, fresh browser per run, clocks begin at local data creation or trusted button handler. Mount/seek/update clocks end at visible Element Timing status marker. Complete visits also verify a visible tile by hit test.
metadata.windowTimings: On the final-row jump, seekBeforeWindowMs ends at the first destination window commit. seekWindowMs covers that commit including slicing and verification. seekRendererMs covers only the synchronous band replacement inside that commit.
metadata.model: One object per record (id, group, score). Full mode mounts one component and visible element per record in 4096-cell bands; native React, Solid and Svelte use a framework root per band. Planned Saba adds two binding comments. Every implementation receives the same immutable per-band record snapshots. Windowed grids have 8 columns and 16 visible rows. Virtual moves on each scroll with two extra rows per side. Buffered replenishes to eight extra rows when three remain.
metadata.checkpoints: DOM count and last-cell layout confirmed for full chunks. Marker presentation sampled every >=32768 cells and at successful completion. Peak is sampled RSS of the isolated browser’s renderer processes, including baseline.
